capabilities.title: Baseline runtime and peak-memory methodology
capabilities.notes: Benchmark inputs and measurement commands are frozen before debt features are added.

capabilities.title: Executable capability matrix validation
capabilities.notes: Validation rejects any implemented or intentionally divergent entry that lacks proof.

capabilities.title: Optional evidence availability fixture state
capabilities.notes: The fixture can render an unavailable evidence state without consulting live services.

capabilities.title: Frozen Git history fixture
capabilities.notes: Fixture history is supplied as deterministic commit records instead of live Git state.

capabilities.title: CLI exit behavior golden fixture
capabilities.notes: The fixture records the exit status and diagnostic text contract used by later debt workflow tests.

capabilities.title: DOT golden fixture
capabilities.notes: DOT ordering is frozen by the executable fixture harness without adding production debt graph rendering.

capabilities.title: JSON golden fixture
capabilities.notes: JSON field and array ordering are frozen for the parity fixture.

capabilities.title: Markdown golden fixture
capabilities.notes: Markdown ordering is frozen by the fixture harness before production debt reporting exists.

capabilities.title: Stable ordering across fixture inputs
capabilities.notes: The harness sorts capabilities and commit edges before rendering every output format.

capabilities.title: Current SCMA metric tests remain gates
capabilities.notes: Existing analyzer and core metric suites are unchanged and continue to run under SwiftPM.

capabilities.title: SwiftPM plugin sources remain gates
capabilities.notes: This ticket preserves plugin source behavior and keeps repository verification on swift build --build-tests and swift test.

capabilities.title: Production debt scoring
capabilities.notes: Debt scoring implementation is intentionally excluded from this acceptance-backbone ticket.
